name: Quality
one_liner: Two qualities: of the development process, and of that process's outputs.
purpose: PM²-Agile references two different but complementary quality types — the quality of the development process and the quality of the outputs of the process. As PM² states, project quality management ensures the project meets the expected results in the most efficient way and that deliverables will be accepted by the relevant stakeholders. Quality is the result of collaborative work, common understanding and empathy between all the stakeholders, and it is an indicator of success when the end user perceives the outputs as useful and intuitive.

fields.what: The first of the two quality types: how the team works, managed by tailoring and by frequent involvement each cycle.
fields.pollux: The way POLLUX runs iterations is itself subject to quality.

fields.what: The second quality type: whether the deliverables of the process meet expectations and get accepted.
fields.pollux: The exposure views themselves, judged against Curie's acceptance criteria.

fields.what: Project quality management ensures the project meets expected results in the most efficient way and deliverables are accepted by relevant stakeholders.
fields.pollux: Deming's Quality & Methods function does not disappear on POLLUX.

fields.what: Quality is the result of collaborative work, common understanding and empathy between all the stakeholders.
fields.pollux: Requires Risk, Finance and the Board to reconcile what they each want.

fields.what: Quality is an indicator of success when the end user perceives the outputs of the process as useful and intuitive.
fields.pollux: One analyst must assemble the quarter-end pack in one day (criterion SC1).

fields.what: Process quality is managed by tailoring the approach that best fits the project environment rather than applying a fixed method.
fields.pollux: Captured in the Development Handbook baselined 27 Nov 2028.

fields.what: Process quality also comes from frequently involving the whole A-PCT, the Business Manager and the User Representatives during each timeboxed cycle.
fields.pollux: Hopper and the reporting analysts are in every fortnight's rhythm.

fields.what: Together they must focus exclusively on generating outcomes that the Project Owner's organisation will perceive as valuable.
fields.pollux: Value is judged by Nightingale's division, not by feature count.

fields.what: Fit-for-purpose deliveries need close collaboration between the Project Owner and Solution Provider organisations, plus agile tools and techniques.
fields.pollux: Nightingale's division and da Vinci's IT division must work as one.

fields.what: Timeboxed cycles of work and frequent user demos provide the time and space for collaborative improvement.
fields.pollux: Iteration Review on the last day of each two-week iteration.

fields.what: This lets the A-PCT assess whether the solution is heading in the desired direction by providing maximum value to business stakeholders.
fields.pollux: Each review tests the portal against the five success criteria.

traps: PM²-Agile names two quality types: the development process and its outputs.
Process quality is managed by tailoring the approach, not by adding controls.
Timeboxed cycles and user demos are quality instruments, not just planning devices.
Quality is judged by the end user's perception of usefulness, not conformance alone.
The Business Manager and User Representatives are part of quality, every cycle.
